question: Which team won their maiden IPL title in 2025 after 18 years of waiting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Royal Challengers Bengaluru.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Royal Challengers Bengaluru won their maiden IPL title in 2025 by defeating Punjab Kings in the final at Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Maiden Title:** RCB ended their 18-year wait for an IPL championship, having been runners-up three times previously.
 
• **Final Match:** RCB defeated Punjab Kings by 6 runs in a closely contested final.
 
• **Strong Bowling Performance:** RCB bowlers, including Krunal Pandya and Josh Hazlewood, played key roles in restricting PBKS.
 
• **Notable Players:** Virat Kohli, Rajat Patidar, and Liam Livingstone contributed significantly to RCB’s winning campaign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **IPL History:** Before 2025, RCB had reached the final three times but had never won the title.
 
• **Punjab Kings:** PBKS were chasing 191 runs but fell short despite crucial knocks from a few batsmen.
 
• **Venue:** The final was held at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad.
 
• **IPL 2025:** Marked by intense competition and featured 10 teams across multiple venues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
